lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var h => cases h
  case app l r i₁ i₂ =>
    right
    obtain (v | ⟨_, h⟩) := i₁ rfl l
    · obtain (w | ⟨_, h₂⟩) := i₂ rfl r
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
        exact ⟨_, .abs v.lc w⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ v h₂⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp _ d s i =>
    have lc := s.wf.2.1.lc
    right
    obtain (v | ⟨_, h⟩) := i rfl d
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
      exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp lc h⟩
  case let' d _ i _ =>
    right
    have b := (body_let.mp der'.wf.2.1).2
    obtain (v | ⟨_, h⟩) := i rfl d
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body v b⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind h b⟩
  case inl d _ i => exact (i rfl d).imp .inl fun ⟨_, h⟩ => ⟨_, .inl h⟩
  case inr d _ i => exact (i rfl d).imp .inr fun ⟨_, h⟩ => ⟨_, .inr h⟩
  case case d _ _ i _ _ =>
    right
    obtain ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1
    obtain (v | ⟨_, h⟩) := i rfl d
    · obtain ⟨u, (rfl|rfl)⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v
      · cases v with | inl w => exact ⟨_, .case_inl w b₂ b₃⟩
      · cases v with | inr w => exact ⟨_, .case_inr w b₂ b₃⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h b₂ b₃⟩
  case sub d _ i => exact i rfl d
  case abs | tabs => grind
